metadata.title: Smallest quotients and profinite rigidity of irreducible spherical type Artin groups
metadata.abstract: We prove that irreducible spherical type Artin groups are profinitely rigid within the class of all spherical type Artin groups. As part of the proof, building on ideas of Kolay for the $n$-strand braid group, we compute the smallest non-abelian quotient of every spherical type Artin group. In particular, given an irreducible spherical type Artin group, its smallest non-abelian quotient is always that of the corresponding Coxeter group, except for dihedral Artin groups of weight divisible by $4$, which all have $\mathfrak S_3$ as a non-abelian quotient. Parts of the proof also rely on the computation of the cohomological dimension of the profinite completion of certain Artin groups.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明不可约球面型 Artin 群在所有球面型 Artin 群中 profinite 刚性，并计算最小非交换商。
analysis.breakthrough: 以可计算的小有限商区分球面型 Artin 群。
analysis.limitations: 刚性比较限于球面型类别；二面体权重被四整除时最小商出现 S₃ 例外。
analysis.priorityReason: 以可计算的小有限商区分球面型 Artin 群。
